seedcracker.title: SeedCracker
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.title: SeedCracker Settings
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.showH: Display the status overlay in the corner of your screen.
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.hudOn: Move the HUD to the top-right corner instead of top-left.
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.showS: Draw coloured boxes at found structure positions in the world.
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.autoS: Automatically begin cracking when enough data is collected.
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.colle: Scan dungeon floors when a spawner block is loaded nearby.
Sample biome data from incoming chunk packets.
Scan nearby blocks for decorator positions.
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.maxSt: How many of each structure type to show after /sf find.
text.autoconfig.seedcracker.option.verbo: Print detailed cracking progress to the game log.
